Footer.blurb: The world's premier platform for horse marketplace, elite clubs, expert trainers, and equestrian community.

Home.heroTitle: Where Every Journey Begins with a Horse

marketplace.title: Global Horse Marketplace
marketplace.subtitle: Discover exceptional horses, premium tack, and trusted equestrian services from verified sellers across six continents.

marketplaceTabs.horsesDesc: Buy, sell, adopt, lease, and stud

clubs.title: Equestrian Clubs
clubs.subtitle: From championship polo grounds to world-class riding academies — find your community among the finest clubs on earth.

blog.title: The LifeOnHorse Journal
blog.subtitle: Thoughtful perspectives on polo heritage, breeding excellence, and the art of horsemanship from leading voices worldwide.

community.title: Global Community
community.subtitle: Celebrate the bond between horse and rider — share moments, stories, and inspiration with fellow enthusiasts worldwide.

horseHealth.title: Horse Health & Expert Help
horseHealth.subtitle: Connect with verified equine experts and get guidance on horse health issues. For emergencies, contact a local veterinarian immediately.
horseHealth.expertDirectoryDesc: Browse vets, farriers, nutrition experts, and other equine specialists. Filter by specialty and location.
horseHealth.askHelpDesc: Describe your horse's symptoms, upload photos, and get connected with the right expert.

trainers.title: Expert Trainers
trainers.subtitle: Connect with Olympic-caliber coaches, master farriers, and renowned equine specialists trusted by champions.

events.title: Equestrian Events
events.subtitle: Polo cups, tent pegging championships, dressage galas, and exclusive clinics — the world's finest calendar awaits.

courses.title: Equestrian Academy
courses.subtitle: From foundational riding to advanced stable management — curated courses taught by the industry's finest minds.

sellers.title: Seller Directory
sellers.subtitle: Find trusted sellers in your region

experts.title: Find an Expert
experts.subtitle: Verified equine veterinarians, farriers, nutritionists, and specialists ready to guide horse health decisions.

horses.title: Horses for Sale
horses.subtitle: Exceptional bloodlines, champion pedigrees, and trusted breeders — discover your next partner in excellence.
